body.p: After , , . Owns src/schema_validate.c, new src/schema_validate_internal.h, src/xdm_node.c (typed values), tests/schema_validate_test.c, tests/xdm_node_test.c. The schema validator as a tree builder (schema.h): element assessment (cvc-elt, cvc-type, cvc-complex-type with the 5.6 matcher, cvc-assess-elt, lax and strict wildcards and the lax mode), xsi:type (cvc-elt.4, blocking), xsi:nil (cvc-elt.3), attribute assessment (cvc-attribute, cvc-assess-attr, attribute wildcards, xsi: attributes), simple values through src/cast.c (cvc-datatype-valid, cvc-simple-type), value constraints (default and fixed values, sent as attributes and content), schema normalized attribute values, the annotations of every element and attribute (invalid and not-assessed parts as XDM 4.0, 3.3.1.1 says), ID and IDREF (cvc-id, is-id, is-idrefs) per validation root, the subtree recorder that keeps an annotated copy of an element's subtree for the packets that evaluate XPath on it (5.8, 5.9), the report sink and error recovery (after an error in content the rest of the element is assessed laxly, so one error gives one report). Typed values derived from string value and annotation in sxml_node_make_typed_value (), with FOTY0012 for element-only content. sxml_schema_validate_node over sxml_tree_builder_copy_node and an arena tree. Done when the in-scope instance tests of MS and Sun pass ≥ 80% and NIST ≥ 95%, and fn:data of a validated 12 of a restriction of xs:integer gives an item of that type (unit test through the public API). Golden: src/arena_tree.c (a builder), src/xslt_whitespace.c (a filtering builder). Done 2026-10-18 (): the validator as a filtering tree builder (content models, wildcards, xsi:type, xsi:nil, attributes, defaults and fixed values, simple values through the cast engine, IDs as XSD 1.1 binds them), the subtree recorder and the type alternative copy for 5.8 and 5.9, sxml_schema_validate_node, derived typed values; the driver validates instance tests and follows location hints. Instance tests in scope: NIST 100 %, MS 95.0 %, Sun 93.9 %; XSD in scope 40,755 of 41,518, slice 147. Not done: inherited attributes for type alternatives (5.9).
